containerAdaptation: The container maps only uid 0 and disallows setuid. The native unmodified PostgreSQL server ran with the retained LD_PRELOAD UID/stat reporting adapter, limited to initdb/pg_ctl/server. Clients and verifier ran without it. It changes UID/ownership reporting, not SQL, locking or MVCC. This is a local adapted environment; ordinary PostgreSQL 17 hosted execution remains required.
